THESIS: the assistant hands you options and gets out of the way.

Every element has to earn its place against one question — does this make the click easier?

REMOVED, and why:

· Search box — the chat already is the search box. A second field competes with it and makes you retype.
· Channel name per card — every result is the same doctor. Said once up top instead of 6 times.
· Card borders/boxes — thumbnails are the content; chrome was competing with them.
· "Watch on YouTube" button — the whole card is the tap target. Two affordances for one action is a hesitation.

REASON SLOT (built, not filled)

Each layout is composed so a one-line "why this matched" drops in under the title with no re-layout.

Left empty today on purpose — with only titles and search metadata, any reason text would be invented confidence. It gets filled when the system actually understands the videos.

DURATION IS PROMOTED. Real results run 0:24 next to 3:29 next to hour-long interviews, so "do I have time for this right now" is the sharpest filter available. Tabular numerals, always legible over any thumbnail.

Play + scrim appear on hover only. Resting state is thumbnail and words — nothing decorative sitting there while you read.

Hover the cards; the states are live.
